passage:
campaign — 运动，活动（为某目的进行的一系列行动）
Last year, the team tested three campaign ideas with three different groups.

proportion — 比例，部分
Group B had the highest proportion of people who walked more.

figure — 数字，数据
In Group A, the figure was 25%.

behaviour — 行为
The team noted that Group A's message reached more people (1,000) than Group B's message (800), but fewer people in Group A changed their behaviour.

effective — 有效的
They believe this message will work well because it was the most effective message for older adults last year.

audience — 受众，目标群体
This shows that reaching a large audience does not always lead to more behaviour change.

city-wide — 全市范围的
They advise campaign planners to test messages with different audiences before using them city-wide.

expect — 预计，期待
They expect the proportion of office workers who walk more to rise from 25% to about 30%.
